script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now with urgent celestial messages. Mars, your fiery ruling planet, is in a powerful conjunction with disciplined Saturn in your 10th House of Career and Public Status. This intense alignment demands focus and may bring challenges that test your leadership, but it also builds lasting foundations. Additionally, Mercury forms a harmonious sextile with Neptune, enhancing intuition in your 12th House of the Subconscious. For love, Venus in your 7th House of Partnerships creates a tense square with Pluto, stirring deep emotions. If single, you might attract someone transformative; if taken, avoid power struggles and communicate openly. In career, the Sun illuminating your 6th House of Daily Work trines innovative Uranus in your 2nd House of Money, suggesting a breakthrough in finances through creative solutions or a sudden opportunity at work. Heed the warning to avoid impulsive purchases, as Mars's aspect could lead to regrets; instead, the blessing comes in the form of a synchronistic encounter that shifts your perspective. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate the cosmic waves ahead.
